payload.body: MAIL -> RULE: thanks, report read. Finding: doctor --fix never rewrites a crossSessionInbound of "hold" (src/setup/mailbox-claude-accept.mjs, fixMailboxClaudeAccept: hold = the person's own choice, skipped; check passes). So no code change is needed to keep it off: if the owner confirms in YOUR window, set crossSessionInbound to "hold" in ~/.claude/settings.json on fg-server (instead of leaving the key absent). Then doctor --fix leaves it alone and mailbox-claude-accept goes green with 'holds by your choice'. This is a suggestion only; apply it only on the owner's word in your window.
